blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Romblon has enacted a comprehensive reproductive health and wellness program for all provincial government employees, according to its social media post on Thursday. Enacted on October 9 during the board’s 35th Regular Session, Provincial Ordinance No. 24, Series of 2026 mandates institutional access to reproductive health education, preventive screening, counseling, and reasonable workplace support across provincial government offices. Board Member Rubelyn S. Solis authored the measure, which covers key health areas including maternal and prenatal care, family planning, menopausal and menstrual health support, screening for sexually transmitted infections (STIs), and early detection […]...
